verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API and a downloadable OpenAPI spec, but nothing documents a first-party, Kimi-branded SDK or client library. Compatibility with other vendors' protocols, which would let users use third-party SDKs, and a raw OpenAPI document that could generate clients are adjacent building blocks, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
